hadur2.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, driven each tick by MeleeController.

    MinimumRiskMovement.candidates(Point2D.Double me, int others, List<EnemyInfo> enemies)
    MinimumRiskMovement.CANDIDATES points on rings around me, capped at MinimumRiskMovement.NEAREST_FRACTION of the nearest opponent's distance and moved inside the field's margin (MMOVE-1).
    List<Point2D.Double>
    MinimumRiskMovement.candidates(Point2D.Double me, int others, List<EnemyInfo> enemies, long now)
    As MinimumRiskMovement.candidates(Point2D.Double, int, List), where only opponents scanned within MinimumRiskMovement.CAP_MAX_AGE ticks of now cap the ring, and the cap is never below MinimumRiskMovement.MIN_RING: an old position must not pin Hadur where the opponent used to be.
